title: Glucomen daypump patch activation problem
body:
I’m new here but i think it’s good to share with u:

for 2 months I’m using aaps with the Glucogen daypump.
When I’m connecting a new patch expediently my screen switched from vertical to horizontal. What happened was that de app started the proces of connecting again. 
I wasn’t able to reconnect with the patch so I needed to pick up a new one. 

So in short terms. The proces of connecting starts over when the screen rotates. This could be nice to be fixen.

Is this something that can be fixed? Or is it only with my type of phone?

I’m using aap 3.2.0.
Having a Motorola e22

comments.body:
I have the same problem. I have to wrap my old pod and paired watch in aluminum foil to prevent them from interfering with the BT connection. Then you'll be fine without losing a pod. 

I am using Galaxy Watch 5 pro 
Glucomen day pump with AAPS 3.2.0-DEV-i 39dd25af07 on Cubot Kingkong mini 2 pro

I have not had this problem while using the Omnipod Dash with the same setup. I've had the Dash for 3 months

Good morning. The same thing happened to me. I updated the AAPS version to the latest dev version available and started the patch change. I was able to correctly discard the previously active patch, but when I tried to activate the new one, it entered a loop and couldn't get past step 1. I switched back to the previous version of AAPS, but it was still stuck in the loop and I eventually lost the patch. I activated the next patch using the previous version I had, and everything worked correctly. I haven't dared to update again since I'm not sure if the problem is resolved, and I have few PODs.

The version when it happened to me was compiled on April 15th at 9:47 AM.

Same problem here, 3 pods worked like a charm but since yesterday it is not possible to pair the pods again. it gets stuck trying to connect and nothing happens.
Using AAPS-DEV version compiled last April, 21st, 2023
Samsung A52s

Hello there,
Still the same problem, this is the order I followed:

1.- Update AAPS to 320 DEV-J build: c86edb94fd-2023.05.14
2.- Deactivate the previous pod in AAPS
3.- Link the new one. Pair identifier was shown twice as expected. Clicked OK.
4.- AAPS gets stuck in "Connecting" and nothing happens.

Then I tried

Remove AAPS cache, didn't work.
Removed all data and restarted aaps configuration -> didn't work

Using Samsung A52s. Android 13.
without logs it's impossible to do anything
